before: In compatibility mode 15 and later, the final space of a right-to-left run hung at the end of a justified passage or line, so the last word of the run could stay there by compressing spaces.
after: That final space stays inside the line, so the word needs room for it and otherwise continues in the next passage or on the next line. A space in its own left-to-right run still hangs.
reason: Only local line breaking changes. Canonical OOXML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged, and every peer derives the same layout from the same document.
